header: How a submission becomes a published paper

items.content: Intake. Compass checks the manuscript against the reproducibility checklist and assigns a handling editor. You get a confirmation within one working day.
Review. Two of our 210 referees read the paper at the same time. The median time to a first decision is 21 days. A third referee joins only if the two disagree.
Production. Accepted papers get a DOI within 48 hours, a copy-edit and a proof for the authors to approve. Print follows the quarterly cycle, and the archive entry goes live on the same day.
